title: Another BRIC Hits A Wall
summary:
Challenges in Brazil could benefit tanker markets
Brazil stays in the spotlight. The Rio Olympics were successfully concluded on August 21. Ten days later, on Wednesday, August 31, Brazil's Senate voted 61-20 to remove Dilma Rousseff as president of the most populous country in Latin America.
